# Directive 2011/83/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 25 October 2011 on consumer rights

Consolidated text as last amended by Directive (EU) 2023/2673. The Directive harmonises the pre-contractual information and the 14-day right of withdrawal for distance and off-premises contracts across the Union.
Article 11a (withdrawal function) applies to contracts concluded from 19 June 2026.
